The '''crested arrow ibbot''' was one of sixty-eight [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[ibbot]], a class of [[Bird/Legends|bird]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Drall (planet)|Drall]] in the [[Corellian sector/Legends|Corellian sector]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. Unlike most other ibbots, which ate [[Algae/Legends|algae]], the crested arrow ibbot was [[Diet/Legends|predatory]]. The species evolved to fit a particular niche in Drall's ecology.<ref name="CatCW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The crested arrow ibbot was mentioned in the [[2003]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' sourcebook ''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]'', published by [[Wizards of the Coast]].<ref name="CatCW" />
